citation.authors: Vleminckx S, Virgilio N, Asserin J, Prawitt J, Silva CIF

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: 85 healthy women aged 43 to 65, East Asian population
record.design: Double-blind randomised placebo-controlled trial, 5 g collagen peptides daily for 84 days, plus a standard face cream
record.finding: Skin density and moisture improved over placebo at 84 days. Nail colour and overall beauty perception improved within 28 days in the collagen group; the placebo group showed the same effects only at 84 days. Hair was not measured.
record.note: The only nail result found, measured as nail colour, not growth or strength. East Asian women only; skin type not reported in the abstract. Funding not stated in the abstract.
